title: Try a grow journal before you sign up
description: Open five example entries and see how notes, photos and follow-ups stay together in a GrowPathAI timeline. No account needed.
disclosure: Synthetic demo — not a customer grow. Dates, notes and readings are invented examples. The basil image is AI-generated, not evidence of a real plant or result.
photoAlt: AI-generated example of a young basil plant in a pot; not a customer photo
screenshotAlt: Actual GrowPathAI timeline interface with five synthetic basil journal entries and an AI-generated example image
screenshotCaption: Actual GrowPathAI interface, shown with synthetic demo data. Not a customer grow or a claimed result.

events.title: Start with a photo and a note
events.summary: Example entry: one basil plant in a pot on the greenhouse bench. Added a starting photo so later notes have a reference. The image is AI-generated for this demo.

events.title: Keep the observation with its date
events.summary: Example entry: the pot felt lighter than at the last check. Wrote down that observation rather than assuming what caused it.

events.title: Record what you actually changed
events.summary: Example entry: recorded a watering and a sample volume of 250 mL. This is made-up journal data, not a watering recommendation for your plant.

events.title: Leave yourself a follow-up
events.summary: Example entry: next time, check the pot again and take a new photo from the same angle. No growth improvement or cause has been established in this sample.

events.title: Look back without hunting through posts
events.summary: Example review: the starting photo, observation, watering note and follow-up are in one dated sequence. Select any earlier point to read it again. In your own account, you decide what to record and what to share.
